categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen JDD Tech New Material Co., Ltd primarily engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of polymer modified protective materials. Its main products include functional protective sleeving widely used in automotive, construction machinery, rail transit, communication electronics, photovoltaic, wind power, energy storage, and medical sectors. The company also produces functional monofilaments and related polymer materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company masters core technologies in polymer modification formulations, product structural design, and molding processes. It employs vertical integration, producing key raw materials like PET, PA, PP, and PE modified monofilaments in-house to ensure quality and cost advantages. Production methods include spinning, weaving, extrusion, composite, and shaping processes, supported by advanced quality management systems such as ISO9001 and IATF16949, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily tier-1 suppliers to major automotive manufacturers including SAIC-GM, Dongfeng Honda, GAC Honda, Dongfeng Nissan, Changan, Great Wall, BYD, NIO, XPeng, Li Auto, GAC Aion, and Seres. Other significant markets include construction machinery (Caterpillar, Bobcat, Sany), rail transit (CRRC), and communication electronics (Molex, TE Connectivity, Corning). The automotive sector, especially new energy vehicles, accounts for over 65% of revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Suzhou, Wuhan, Chongqing, and Jiangmen. It has expanded internationally with a manufacturing subsidiary in Mexico and plans to establish a subsidiary in Morocco. The company serves domestic and overseas markets, including North America and emerging regions such as Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: JDD Tech operates primarily as a midstream supplier in the polymer modified protective materials industry. It serves as a secondary supplier to tier-1 suppliers who then supply major OEMs. The company extends upstream by producing key raw materials like functional monofilaments internally, enabling vertical integration and control over quality and costs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in polymer modification formulations and product design to meet evolving customer needs, especially in emerging sectors like aerospace, wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage, medical, low-altitude economy (e.g., flying cars, drones), and humanoid robots. R&D focuses on high-performance materials with enhanced heat resistance, UV resistance, flame retardancy, and mechanical strength. It also invests in expanding production capacity and intelligent manufacturing systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of polymer modified protective materials and related products to tier-1 suppliers and end customers. The company operates a direct sales model, providing customized product solutions and technical support. Revenue is primarily from product sales, with a small portion from rental income related to subleased factory space.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The domestic market comprises three types of competitors: multinational corporations with advanced technology and scale, leading domestic enterprises with growing R&D capabilities and cost advantages, and small-scale producers with limited capabilities. JDD Tech is positioned as a leading domestic player with strong technical capabilities, vertical integration, a broad product portfolio, and a solid customer base, competing closely with foreign brands in performance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 864.5 million, a 34.3% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 176 million, up 26%. Total assets reached RMB 1.5 billion, growing 82% from the previous year. The company completed its IPO in March 2024, raising RMB 558.2 million, marking a new growth phase with accelerated market expansion and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JDD Tech offers high-performance polymer modified protective materials with superior heat resistance, UV resistance, flame retardancy, chemical resistance, and mechanical durability. Its vertical integration ensures stable quality and cost competitiveness. The company provides customized, one-stop solutions including product design, process development, testing, and after-sales support, enabling rapid response to diverse customer requirements and fostering long-term partnerships with leading OEMs.
